outcome: No renderer candidate ships. All 520 complete definitions, original source assets and generated catalog remain unchanged. The instanced GPU prototype is fast in two CPU4 observations but fails literal reference pixels; the hybrid retains additional original Canvas draws, still fails exact pixels and measures slower. Keep the original renderer and its unresolved timing gate.
scope: Native Reactive Threads renderer research. No whole-handoff, accessibility, cold-route, compositor-presentation or final 60fps acceptance claim.
findings: All valid comparison candidates preserve the immutable full source factory and pass the existing 31,202 model/command checks. Renderer checks stop at the first unequal checkpoint; they do not certify later checkpoints or later DPR/motion cases.

Atlas, pattern and initial GPU variants change native pixel bytes. The bounds-corrected GPU candidate used in the timing sample differs in thirteen alpha channels at its first DPR1 checkpoint, by one byte each. Interpolated texture coordinates reduce that first-checkpoint count to eleven, without establishing complete equivalence.

Isolated original Canvas primitives distinguish image edge coverage, path clipping, canvas-boundary clipping and overlap. These are empirical observations for the measured browser and adapter, not portable browser contracts.

The hybrid masks GPU edge pixels, renders selected original Canvas columns and applies a binary mask after painting. An outer clip mask itself changed two reference pixels and was rejected. Later float-filter and operation-order variants still leave literal alpha differences. Initial shader identifier collisions are retained as failed setup, not renderer results.

The measured hybrid still draws 1,330 original CPU columns on desktop and 1,198 on compact at the final sampled state, plus 1,854/4,503 binary-mask row runs. Its observed rate is worse than the original renderer; this hybrid is rejected.

A temporary shader-dump attempt produced no shader source. Browser-level SystemInfo reports GraphiteDawnD3D11 and the AMD adapter, but that metadata does not attest the backend of an individual Canvas2D surface.

measurements.method: Three sequential variants, each with one eight-second desktop DPR1 and one compact DPR2 native story, CPU slowdown 4. Fonts are prepared; six Dock actions are dispatched. Own heavy checks do not overlap these profiles; other host applications are uncontrolled. This is not ABBA or a stable timing acceptance test. RequestAnimationFrame callback cadence is not compositor presentation cadence.
